title: Matching ecological indicator claims to evidence in grazing assessment — reproducibility materials
license_scope: MIT: original Python code/tests; CC BY 4.0: original data, documentation, configuration and figure outputs. Retained third-party notices and method-parameter exclusions: NOTICE.md and metadata/file_rights.json.
description: Deterministic Python reproduction of five stipulated synthetic grazing-assessment cases and Figure 1. Includes synthetic inputs, protocol/configuration, source, 25 unit tests, expected outputs and reproduction instructions. No field observations or ecological validation are supplied.
funding: FAPESP postdoctoral fellowship 2025/04640-1 awarded to Michael Allim Jorge. The funder had no role in conceptual design, development or analysis of the synthetic scenarios, interpretation, preparation of the manuscript, or decision to submit.
